paras.en: It took me a long time to understand where he came from. The little prince, who asked me so many questions, never seemed to hear mine. Little by little, his chance remarks revealed everything to me. For instance, when he first saw my aeroplane (I will not draw my aeroplane; it is far too complicated a drawing for me), he asked:
paras.zh: 我花了很长时间，才弄明白他从哪里来。小王子问了我许多问题，却似乎从来听不见我的问题。是他无意间说出的话，让我一点一点明白了一切。比如，他第一次看见我的飞机时（我不会把我的飞机画出来，这幅画对我来说实在太复杂了），就问我：

paras.en: “What is that thing there?”
paras.zh: “那是什么东西？”

paras.en: “It is not a thing. It flies. It is an aeroplane. It is my aeroplane.”
paras.zh: “那可不叫什么‘东西’。它会飞。那是飞机。那是我的飞机。”

paras.en: And I was proud to tell him that I flew. Then he cried out:
paras.zh: 我很自豪地告诉他，我会开飞机。于是他叫了起来：

paras.en: “What! You fell from the sky!”
paras.zh: “什么！你是从天上掉下来的！”

paras.en: “Yes,” I said modestly.
paras.zh: “是的。”我谦虚地说。

paras.en: “Ah! That is funny!…”
paras.zh: “啊！这可真好笑！……”

paras.en: And the little prince let out a lovely burst of laughter, which annoyed me very much. I want people to take my misfortunes seriously. Then he added:
paras.zh: 小王子发出一阵十分悦耳的笑声，却惹得我很恼火。我希望别人认真对待我的不幸。接着他又说：

paras.en: “So you come from the sky too! Which planet are you from?”
paras.zh: “这么说，你也是从天上来的！你来自哪颗星球？”

paras.en: At once I glimpsed a faint light in the mystery of his presence, and I asked abruptly:
paras.zh: 在他出现的谜团中，我立刻瞥见了一丝微光，便突然问道：

paras.en: “So you come from another planet?”
paras.zh: “这么说，你是从另一个星球来的？”

paras.en: But he did not answer me. He was nodding gently as he looked at my plane:
paras.zh: 可他没有回答我。他望着我的飞机，轻轻点着头：

paras.en: “It’s true, you can’t have come from very far in that…”
paras.zh: “倒也是，坐着这个，你不可能从很远的地方来……”

paras.en: And he sank into a daydream that lasted a long time. Then, taking my sheep out of his pocket, he became absorbed in gazing at his treasure.
paras.zh: 接着，他陷入了久久的遐想。然后，他从口袋里掏出我的绵羊，出神地凝望着他的宝贝。

paras.en: You can imagine how intrigued I was by this half-told secret about “the other planets”. So I tried to find out more:
paras.zh: 你们可以想象，他对“别的星球”这番只透露了一半的话，让我多么好奇。于是我努力想多问出一些来：

paras.en: “Where do you come from, my little fellow? Where is ‘your home’? Where do you want to take my sheep?”
paras.zh: “小家伙，你从哪里来？‘你家’在哪里？你想把我的绵羊带到哪里去？”

paras.en: After a thoughtful silence, he answered me:
paras.zh: 他默默想了一会儿，才回答我：

paras.en: “The good thing about the box you gave me is that at night it will be a house for him.”
paras.zh: “你给我的箱子有个好处，到了夜里，它就能给绵羊当房子。”

paras.en: “Of course. And if you’re good, I’ll also give you a rope to tie him up during the day. And a stake.”
paras.zh: “当然啦。要是你乖，我还会给你一根绳子，白天可以用来拴住它。还有一根木桩。”

paras.en: The suggestion seemed to shock the little prince:
paras.zh: 这个提议似乎让小王子有些难以接受：

paras.en: “Tie it up? What a strange idea!”
paras.zh: “把它拴起来？这想法真奇怪！”

paras.en: “But if you don’t tie it up, it will go anywhere, and it will get lost…”
paras.zh: “可你要是不把它拴起来，它就会到处走，会迷路的……”

paras.en: And my friend burst out laughing again:
paras.zh: 我的朋友又放声笑了起来：

paras.en: “But where do you think it could go!”
paras.zh: “可你想，它能去哪儿呀！”

paras.en: “Anywhere. Straight ahead…”
paras.zh: “哪儿都可能。一直朝前走……”

paras.en: Then the little prince said seriously:
paras.zh: 这时，小王子认真地说：

paras.en: “That doesn’t matter. It’s so small where I live!”
paras.zh: “那没关系，我住的地方小得很！”

paras.en: And, with a little sadness, perhaps, he added:
paras.zh: 接着，他又说，或许带着一点忧伤：

paras.en: “Going straight ahead, you can’t get very far…”
paras.zh: “一直朝前走，是走不了多远的……”
